        params = {
            "n_estimators": trial.suggest_int("n_estimators", 500, 2000),
            "learning_rate": trial.suggest_float("learning_rate", 0.01, 0.1, log=True),
            "max_depth": trial.suggest_int("max_depth", 3, 12),

            "objective": "reg:squarederror",
            "eval_metric": "rmse",
            "random_state": SEED,
            "verbosity": 0,
            "tree_method": "hist",
            "device": "cuda" if GPU_AVAILABLE else "cpu",
            # Tells XGBoost to automatically encode pandas category dtypes
            "enable_categorical": True, 
        }


        model = XGBRegressor(**params)
        model.fit(X_train_nl, y_train, eval_set=[(X_val_nl, y_val)], verbose=False)
        y_pred = model.predict(X_val_nl)
        return np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, y_pred))


    xgb_study = optuna.create_study(direction="minimize", sampler=TPESampler(seed=SEED))
    xgb_study.optimize(objective_xgb, n_trials=50, show_progress_bar=True)
